reference_text: Ethos以证据连接人的判断与agent的行动。OpenSpec保存正式接受的意图，证据记录实际发生的事，看清关系，决定下一步，条件改变就重新判断。
scope: Approved synthetic narrator identity root used unmodified, with the transcript, temperature and in-context repetition penalty that the revision-7 samples the user approved on 2026-11-02 were narrated with: no time-stretch, pitch shift or recast.
